question: Nongkrem and Laho are the popular dances of which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• **Nongkrem Dance** is one of the most significant cultural festivals of Meghalaya, celebrated by the Khasi tribe.

• **Laho Dance** is another traditional dance from Meghalaya, performed by the Pnar community during the Behdienkhlam festival.

• Both dances are performed with elaborate traditional costumes and are often accompanied by traditional music and instruments.

• These dances are not only a form of entertainment but also a means of preserving and showcasing the rich cultural heritage of Meghalaya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Nongkrem Dance**

• The Nongkrem Dance Festival is a five-day religious festival held annually at Smit, the cultural center of the Khasi Hills.

• It is celebrated to appease the Goddess Ka Blei Synshar for a rich harvest and prosperity of the people.

• The dance involves both men and women dressed in traditional attire, performing intricate steps and movements.

• The male dancers hold a sword in one hand and a white yak hair whisk in the other, while the female dancers wear a crown of silver and gold on their heads.

• **Laho Dance**

• The Laho Dance is performed during the Behdienkhlam festival, which is the most important festival of the Pnar community in the Jaintia Hills.

• Behdienkhlam is celebrated to drive away the plague and ensure a good harvest.

• The Laho Dance involves both men and women dancing together in a circle, holding hands and following the rhythm of the music.

• The dancers wear colorful traditional attire, with the women wearing a 'Dhara' (traditional dress) and the men wearing a 'Jymphong' (long coat).
